name: SIQ - Image Grid Light
description: Clean, modern image grid gallery with light theme. Add unlimited images with optional titles, captions, links, and hover overlays. Flexible 2–4 columns on desktop, auto-adjust on mobile. Features hover animations (zoom, fade, lift), border radius control, gap customization, aspect ratio options, and fully adjustable background/text colors. Perfect for portfolios, product showcases, editorial galleries, and brand stories. 70+ customization options.
author: SectionIQ
